title: Sound evaluation: live T-34 duel through actual ammunition catastrophe and terminal fade
caption: COMMANDER CUPOLA / LIVE T-34 AT 150 M / TERMINAL OUTCOME
input_audit: Derived from pilot_cupola_t34_duel_20260929.v1.json with identical setup, hatch at 0.2 s, one disclosed staged own-gun discharge at 7 s, and drive input from 12 to 19 s. The original live enemy detection, firing, flight and damage are unchanged. This 20 s evaluation expects the observed actual ammunition catastrophe, then the ordinary terminal fade; it does not inject death or select an impact outcome. Remaining drive input after death is recorded as ignored. No postmortem own-gun action is scheduled.
historical_scope: A sound-level demonstration on the training arena, not a historical engagement.
visual_acceptance: Buttoned cupola, live enemy reports and armour strikes, own 88 at 7 s, actual ammunition catastrophe, frozen fatal frame fading to black with the same audio fade. No fabricated replay, continued driving or postmortem shot.
evaluation_scope: Compare the common pre-death encounter and terminal fade. The original 34 s baseline remains preserved as historical evidence with an old recorder defect: its 27 s staged discharge mutated a dead player and falsely satisfied its two-shot check. Its postmortem acceptance is invalid. This shorter fixture must pass one-shot, actual death and ammunition-detonation checks with the repaired terminal latch.
